Package paint.compare

Class PaintStrictComparator

java.lang.Object
paint.compare.PaintStrictComparator
All Implemented Interfaces:
FieldComparator
public final class PaintStrictComparator extends Object implements FieldComparator
A FieldComparator that reproduces the strict per-field decision sequence of the original CsvComparatorRegression — so the generic TableComparer yields the same Java-vs-Java verdicts the old tool did.

The rules themselves are reused verbatim from RegressionRules (rather than re-implemented) so behaviour cannot silently drift from the original. In order, two values for a column are treated as equal when:

  1. the column is a case-insensitive field and the values match ignoring case;
  2. one side is empty and the other is a zero/sentinel value;
  3. the trimmed strings match, or both round to three decimals equally;
  4. one numeric side is missing (empty/NaN) — treated as not a difference;
  5. both parse as numbers and, after any track-count-dependent correction, fall within the field's strict rounding/relative tolerance.
Columns flagged by RegressionRules.isIgnoredColumn(java.lang.String, boolean) (strict), and blank column names, are skipped entirely.
